decisions.reason: Authenticated transport and generation lifecycle are consumed through ctx.remote; direct ClientConnectionRpc or transport hooks are gateway/boot integration, not normal business plugin task.
ctx.fileUpload.upload is a public Session-addressed browser upload service; retain FileUploadService and FileUploadProgress.
Client module states desktop renderer analytics; browser applications have no collection capability, and product event vocabulary is product-specific telemetry.
Public createSnapshotStore and defineStore are used by slot state owners; retain as supporting contract.
CommandUiRuntime.register/decorate is the public slash-menu extension seam; new API and task documented.
Pure docking engine and React kit under right-sidebar owner; tab plugins use sidebarRightTabs and keyed tab slot rather than mutating layout engine directly.
ctx.layout exposes selectPanel and beginNavigation for cross-plugin main-panel navigation; rightbar presentation methods remain owner-facing.
Concrete feedback UI contribution into assistant-actions and command overlay; its exported dialog props describe this built-in feature, while generic entry is slot/command contract.
Built-in /model contribution and conversation.input.model seat consume shared command UI and slot contracts; ModelDirectory is feature catalog, not a generic registration service.
Built-in @file/@session source is an implementation of InputTriggerSource; use input-trigger contract to add a new source.
Session selector hooks, status and pending-interaction publisher support session-scoped UI; document further when task calls for a domain pending-interaction flow.
Sidebar shell declares sidebar.panellist and related slots; a third-party panel uses slot registration and ctx.layout.selectPanel.
Built-in HTTP(S) Browser tab demonstrates right-sidebar registry/slot path, but BrowserControllerState and address types serve that viewer.
Built-in workspace file tree tab demonstrates right-sidebar registry/slot path; FilesState and FilesInjected are feature internals.
sidebarRightTabs register plus keyed body slot and ctx.sidebarRight navigation are public extension contracts.
Built-in trajectory event ledger contributes a conversation view; public TrajectoryContribution is feature-specific whereas ViewDefinition and slot are generic seams.
Built-in workspace picker fills sidebar.workspaces and conversation.hero.workspace slots; DirectoryPickingHooks are picker-owner integration, not a generic independent picker backend.

note: Package dispositions are scoped to general plugin-author tasks; they do not erase separate individual API symbol candidates.
